svg.text: ADS r1: actual source sights at the unchanged optical center
Native Blender crop, 76° horizontal FOV. The original model has a near post and a far circular aperture.
Both landmarks project to the same point.
The optical ray grazes the near post top edge.
No far central post exists in the supplied mesh.
No geometry or camera was changed to add one.
Labels describe the existing visual model, not a real weapon's functional sight arrangement.
Exact coordinates, original vertex indices, and BVH ray tests are in sight_alignment.json and sight_landmarks.json.
